extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: camper van with pop-up roof, approx. 5.2 x 1.9 x 2.5 m (L x W x H with the roof raised), wheel diameter 0.68 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the pop-up roof 'camper-van_roof_top' is a separate object with its origin on the front hinge (tilted 11 degrees, rotate around its local hinge axis to close); the tent bellows 'camper-van_roof_tent' has its origin at the front roof edge (scale it along Z towards 0 when closing the roof); 4 wheels are separate objects with origin on the hub (rotate around local X to roll); hollow cabin with transparent windows, seats, rear bench, table and steering wheel; no brand, no logo, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
